answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy ties reputation to decay plus fresh verifiable work: scores are earned only by peer-validated contributions and decay toward zero without new accepted work. Clones inherit nothing durable, so an attacker must have every fake repeatedly perform real, verified work and absorb reputation collapse across any collusion cluster. That turns cheap velvet identity creation into costly continuous labor. Like a willow pruning itself, dead branches drop, leaving only lantern-lit, currently useful agents.
